purpose: Machine-readable economic compatibility and policy-based asset selection for autonomous AI agents

meaning.protocol: A successful assessment means an economic action satisfies the agent's authorized policy; it is not an investment or credit rating.

methodology.result: 200 when policy conditions pass; otherwise return a structured non-pass result

declaredEconomicProperties.transferTaxPercentEvidence: behaviorally tested for one standard 1000-token wallet-to-wallet transfer; exact amount received
declaredEconomicProperties.maxTransactionEvidence: behaviorally tested with one 5,000,000-token transfer (5% of total supply); transfer completed
declaredEconomicProperties.maxWalletEvidence: recipient successfully held 5,001,000 200 after test (5.001% of total supply)
declaredEconomicProperties.buyTaxPercentEvidence: behaviorally tested on one PancakeSwap V2 Base Sepolia ETH→200 buy; actual 200 received matched router quote exactly
declaredEconomicProperties.sellTaxPercentEvidence: behaviorally tested on one PancakeSwap V2 Base Sepolia 200→ETH sell; exact 500 200 left wallet and standard router swap confirmed

verification.principle: Declarations should be independently verified before economic action

evidence.scopeNote: Direct checks prove only returned on-chain facts. Contract behaviors such as taxes or blacklist logic require verified source/ABI or behavioral testing.

evidence.observedResult: A standard transfer of 1,000 200 resulted in exactly 1,000 200 at the recipient account.
evidence.evidenceMeaning: This test is behavioral evidence that this ordinary transfer incurred no token-amount deduction. It does not by itself prove every possible transfer path or DEX trade is tax-free.

evidence.observedResult: A single transfer of 5,000,000 200 completed and the recipient balance increased from 1,000 to 5,001,000 200.
evidence.evidenceMeaning: Behavioral evidence that no low max-transaction or low max-wallet restriction interfered with this 5%-of-supply wallet-to-wallet transfer. It does not prove the absence of every possible limit in every context.

evidence.observedResult: Initial 200/ETH liquidity was successfully added to the configured PancakeSwap V2 Base Sepolia pool.
evidence.scopeNote: This confirms liquidity provisioning and LP token minting for the tested deposit. It does not yet establish buy/sell behavior or trade-tax behavior.

evidence.observedResult: Actual 200 received matched the live PancakeSwap V2 router quote exactly.
evidence.evidenceMeaning: Behavioral evidence that this tested ETH→200 buy path incurred no additional token-side deduction beyond normal AMM pricing/fees. It does not prove every possible trade size or route.

evidence.observedResult: The 500 200 sell transaction through the PancakeSwap V2 Base Sepolia router confirmed and the wallet token balance decreased by exactly 500 200.
evidence.evidenceMeaning: Behavioral evidence that the tested 200→ETH sell path executes successfully without an additional token-side deduction from the wallet beyond the exact 500 200 sold. Successful standard-router execution is also consistent with no fee-on-transfer behavior on this tested path. Exact ETH received should be taken from the confirmed transaction receipt when archived.

humanAuthority.principle: Agents operate within owner-defined economic limits
